Message from you:
Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
Absolutely. Here’s a simple way to get started with your new Alen:
Take it out of the box and remove all protective films. The filter is already inside the unit, so open the front panel and unwrap it.
Place your purifier along your room’s longest wall, at least 18 inches away from furniture.
Plug it in, press the power button, and leave it running 24/7 for best results.
Register your purifier using its serial number and purchase information to activate the Forever Guarantee.
Consider setting up a Filter Subscription for replacement filters, 10% off each filter, free shipping, and reward points.
Connect your purifier to Wi-Fi using the Alen Air app to control it remotely, monitor air quality, and receive filter-replacement notifications.
You can begin at alen.com/pages/onboarding.
